**Checklist:**

- [ ] One topic per pull request, rebased on `main`, no merge commits
- [ ] Superseded pull requests closed and linked
- [ ] Regression dataset documents and pages named, or a dataset pull request that adds a new document
- [ ] Before/after evidence for each cited page
- [ ] Rendering only: pypdfium2 comparison images, corpus-wide metrics table, and an enforced image regression test
- [ ] Blend2D only: link to the upstream report
- [ ] Changes to existing ground truth listed with the reason for each page
